description: Defines the Timesheet entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including properties, ORM mappings, and methods related to timesheet data.

classes.name: Timesheet
classes.description: Entity class representing a timesheet with properties for ID, state, start and end dates, and associated employee, with ORM mappings.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the timesheet.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the state of the timesheet.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the timesheet.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the timesheet.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the timesheet.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the timesheet.
